title.narrative: EU Support to Food Security and Resilience in Taraba State, Nigeria

description.narrative: The objective of the action is to improve the food security, nutrition and resilience of vulnerable groups in Taraba State. This action aims to strengthen the resilient livelihoods and socioeconomic development of the people through social protection/safety nets and strengthening market system. The framework coherently addresses short-term targeted agricultural outcomes amongst the rural populace in 6 LGAs.
